response.text:
I can do that — quick clarifying questions before I reschedule:

1. Which Friday do you mean (date)? or is this a recurring weekly meeting?
2. What exact event should I move (event title/calendar) so I reschedule the right item?
3. When you say “4pm my time,” what is your time zone?  
4. Do you want the meeting at 8:00 AM London time, or 8:00 AM your time?
5. Change just this occurrence or the whole series?
6. May I check attendees’ availability and then send updated invites when I reschedule?

Reply with those details and a confirmation to proceed and I’ll make the change.
